title: pm-daily-scratchpad-2026-04-08
content:
2026-04-08 PM scratchpad - Sofia Chen

Top priorities (today)
- Finalize PRD edits for 0.9.1 feature flags + canary rollout (target: next week).
- Sync with infra on autoscale policy experiments: need confirmation on burst capacity behavior under heavy prefix-caching.
- Prepare launch checklist for hosted API small customers (beta) and send to CS + Legal.

Meetings
- 09:00 sync (ENG-serving-runtime) - kernel selection for short-context models (action: Jordan to share perf numbers by EOD).
- 10:30 stakeholder review (product + sales) - demo flow + pricing notes. Keep demo showing latency improvement for quantized models.
- 14:00 SRE on rollout plan - discuss traffic shaping and fallback to compatible model variant.

PRD edits to make (inline notes)
- Section: rollout policy - add explicit failure-mode behavior: if canary p95 > target for 10m -> automatic rollback and alert to on-call.
- Section: cost controls - call out per-route token budget and throttling policy (example thresholds).
- API examples: add streaming example and function-calling snippet (JS + Python).
- Metrics: add 'tokens-per-invocation' baseline and expected reduction from KV prefix caching (approx 15-30%). Source: experiment results from infra/bench-2026-03-30.

Stakeholder follow-ups
- Jordan M: send perf CSV and perf/latency breakdown by model variant (due: EOD).
- Aisha P (Growth): standard messaging for beta users + churn mitigation notes (due: 4/10).
- Legal (Priya): check privacy language for Private deployment docs (ask about KMS/HSM wording).
- CS (Diego): prepare onboarding checklist for dedicated customers (focus on network config + VPC peering gotchas).

Launch checklist (hosted-beta small cohort) - quick draft
- [ ] Finalize PRD & get product sign-off (owner: me)
- [ ] Confirm autoscale policy defaults with infra (owner: Jordan)
- [ ] Create feature flags and canary cohort in console (owner: platform-eng)
- [ ] Update SDK examples + changelog (owner: devexp)
- [ ] Prepare customer-facing one-pager + support runbook (owner: CS)
- [ ] Legal review on data handling + KMS (owner: Legal)
- [ ] Monitoring dashboards: p50/p95 latency, error rate, tokens/invocation, cost-per-token (owner: observability)
- [ ] Rollout plan doc + rollback steps (owner: SRE)

Risks / open questions
- Latency regression risk for long-context quantized runs - need deeper perf matrix across seq len.
- Autoscale burst may cause cost spike in first week; consider soft limits for beta.
- Will private deployments require different SDK auth flows? note: customers asked for HSM integration example.

Notes to self / loose thoughts
- Consider adding a short 'expected behavior' section in Console for feature flags to reduce support tickets.
- Quick A/B idea: default to cheaper model variant under high concurrency and show notification in response metadata. Might help cost for SaaS customers.

Tomorrow (quick plan)
- Review Jordan's numbers; fold into PRD and update metrics section.
- Draft email to beta cohort with instructions + expected SLOs.
- Follow up with Legal on KMS wording.

TODO (explicit)
- Send PRD v0.9.1 to product mailing list (include linked confluence + PR). (due 2026-04-09)
- Create GH issue for SDK streaming example missing tests (owner: devexp).
- Schedule 30m with SRE for rollout dry-run (owner: me).

Quick links/refs
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PROD/API-rollout
- Jira: JIRA-8421 (feature-flag rollout)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/128

Random snippets saved here:
- "If canary p95 > target for 10m -> rollback" -> add as automated policy in console
- example toast text: "Rolling back to stable model due to latency regression"

End of notes.
